name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 6 visits over 15 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 16 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 15 hours starting 2025-06-06, at wavelengths from 0.94 to 4.84 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
